entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I have this VeloBand Pulse monitor and... I just don't think I can use it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh. I don't think it's broken. It's just... confusing. It's not what I expected at all and I feel a bit overwhelmed by it. I just want to send it back.
I understand. So it sounds like it's just not the right fit for you, which is perfectly fine. Let me pull up your order information and I'll check the return options for you. One moment.

Alright, I see your order. It was delivered 39 days ago. Now, for wearable devices like this that have direct skin contact, we typically have a very short return window for hygiene and sanitation reasons.
Oh, no. Does that mean it's too late for me? The website was so confusing, I didn't see anything about that. Can't you just help me?

Please hold on, let me just confirm the exact company policy for your purchase... (typing sounds) ... Okay! Actually, it looks like you're in luck. My system is showing our standard return policy is 90 days from the delivery date.
Really? So I can return it?
Yes. Since you're only at day 39, you are well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you, thank you so much! I was so worried.

You're very welcome, I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack everything back in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once our warehouse receives it.
That sounds easy enough. Thank you again, Alex.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
